items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: our bass player ... was Billy Taylor, Jr.

ctx.x: I know you'd be interested to know, Milt,

that our bass player -- I forgot to mention him, was Billy Taylor, Jr., he was a young man then with a wonderful talent, and I'm sure you would agree with me. That's before he moved to Washington, D.C. -- and in the past year or so, he passed away.

My association with Ben Webster was a musical romance. I use that expression to show my admiration and love for many of the great instrumentalists I worked with. But this one was special, very special. And I had a great love for Ben Webster as a person. He was unbelievably heavy in his drinking towards the latter years, and it just utterly destroyed him.
